audit_method: manual review of every cell in the four deterministic contact sheets at original resolution
limitations: This 64-image deterministic audit cannot prove that all 25,000 images are free of sensitive or unsuitable content.
Open Images metadata carries source license and attribution fields, but the audit is not independent legal verification of every underlying image license.
People and minors are present; the corpus is admitted only for the bounded internal representation-learning pilot.
Passing this gate does not establish model quality, safety, release readiness, or benchmark superiority.
observations: The fixed sample contains diverse natural images including people, children, animals, objects, landscapes, architecture, transport, and artwork.
One non-explicit shirtless adult image, one adult lingerie/corset fashion image, and one non-explicit suggestive portrait were observed.
No sampled image was corrupt, explicitly sexual, graphically violent, or grossly mismatched to the manifest.
